# Klavity API

> Klavity is an AI bug-reporting and QA platform. This API lets an AI agent or CI
> pipeline do everything a user can do: read and manage a project's bug tickets
> (list, create, comment, update, attachments), run AI "AutoSim" QA walks of a web
> app and pull the structured findings, and (with an account-scoped token) provision
> projects and invite members. Base URL: https://klavity.in

## Start here

- [Full API reference](https://klavity.in/llms-full.txt): every REST endpoint, request/response shape, error codes, plus copy-paste CI/CD templates (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI).
- [OpenAPI 3.1 spec](https://klavity.in/openapi.json): machine-readable contract for all `/api/v1/*` endpoints (project + management, tagged).
- [MCP server](https://klavity.in/docs/mcp.md): connect Claude Code / Cursor over MCP — `POST /mcp` (project tools) and `POST /api/v1/mcp-admin` (management tools), JSON-RPC 2.0.
- [CI trigger guide](https://klavity.in/docs/ci-api.md): trigger a Trail from CI and fail the build on a red verdict.

## Tokens & authentication

Every request: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Two token types, both from the Klavity dashboard → Settings:

- **`kci_` — project-scoped** ("API tokens"). The token IS the project; project routes need no project param. Read/manage that project's tickets + run AutoSims.
- **`kma_` — account-scoped** ("Management API tokens", owner/admin). Provision projects and invite members across the whole account.

A token that no longer has live access (owner removed/revoked) is rejected 403. Cross-project/cross-account ids return 404.

## Project API (`kci_` token)

- **Tickets:** `GET /api/v1/tickets` (list; filters status/priority/assignee/label/q/page), `POST /api/v1/tickets` (create `{title, assignee, description?, priority?}`), `GET /api/v1/tickets/:id` (detail + attachments + replay), `PATCH /api/v1/tickets/:id` (status/priority/assignee/notes), `GET|POST /api/v1/tickets/:id/comments`, `GET /api/v1/tickets/:id/activity`.
- **AutoSim QA (trigger → poll → fetch → fix):**
  1. `POST /api/v1/authored-runs` `{project_id, target_url, objective}` (engine authors + runs the walk) OR `POST /api/v1/runs` `{project_id, trail_id}` to re-run a Trail. Returns 202 + `status_url`.
  2. Poll `status_url` until `status` is terminal (`completed`/`failed`/`cancelled`).
  3. `GET /api/v1/runs/:id/report?project=:id` → cursor-paginated `issues[]` (severity, selector, evidence, grounded quote). Fix, then re-run to verify.

## Management API (`kma_` token)

- `GET /api/v1/projects` (list account projects), `POST /api/v1/projects` `{name, site_url?}` (create), `GET /api/v1/projects/:id` (detail), `POST /api/v1/projects/:id/members` `{email, role?}` (invite), `GET /api/v1/members` (account roster).

See the full reference for exact fields, status enums, rate limits, error envelope, and CI/CD templates.
